title: Medical Debt's Share of All Credit-Report Collections

source.name: Medical Debt Burden in the United States

notes: CFPB research found medical debt made up the majority of third-party collections tradelines appearing on consumer credit reports — commonly cited at roughly 58% — before the 2022-2023 reporting changes. Recalled from CFPB's published research; not live-refreshed this run because outbound network access was unavailable in this session.
